維持高檔下，營運可望續創新高，維持買進投資建議，目標價由158 元
(2.4 x 修正前27(F) PB)調升至230 元(2.4 x 修正後27(F) PB)。

維持買進評等，目標價上調至218 元，潛在上漲空間20%：
1. 2Q26記憶體毛利率升抵70.3%，EPS約達5.40元，數字符合預期。 
2. ECB已完全轉換，股本由450億元升至472億元，本文EPS數字以舊股本計 
3. 3Q26記憶體價格漲幅約30-50%，DRAM漲勢最佳。

We keep our PT unchanged at NT$288: We continue to apply P/B multiple methodology
to derive our price target, in line with our approach for Greater China memory IDM peers
and in view of the industry's high earnings volatility. Our price target (base-case scenario
value) implies 5.7x 2026e BVPS and 2.9x 2027e BVPS vs. our prior target multiples of 6.2x
2026e and 3.4x 2027e BVPS, to reflect the higher equity risk premium due to the
volatility. Our bull- and bear-case scenario values are unchanged at NT$342.00 and NT
$118.00, respectively, implying 3.4x and 1.2x 2027e BVPS, respectively.

2026 年和2027 年EPS 分別上修至24.43 元和47.63 元。考量今明
年獲利持續上修，並啟動高雄廠擴產計畫，維持買進，TP 225 元。

看好：1) AI基礎建設為記憶體產業上升週期提供長期成長動能；
2)大廠退出2D NAND市場，華邦電將受惠於SLC NAND缺口紅利；3)五成產能已簽署長約為長期需求能見度提升; 4)
CUBE及Si-Cap有望帶動2027年後新?輪長期成長，上修預估2027年營收至5,929.6億元，毛利率80%，稅後EPS 66.57
元，給予3.2倍PB，維持「買進」之投資評等，目標價220元(3.2倍PBR*2026BVPS(F))。

Winbond’s 2Q26 results showed 4%/12% revenue and EPS beat vs. consensus.
Winbond believes the supply tightness will be more serious in 2027 than in 2026.
Winbond’s Kaohsiung Fab Module A DRAM capacity remains on track to reach
24kwpm wafer-in by end-2026, while it announced a Greenfield expansion of
Module B (50-60kwpm total capacity, divided into phases) with production from
4Q29. Key demand drivers include eSSD DRAM, AI server NOR flash, SLC
NAND, CUBE and silicon capacitor (Si Cap). Winbond is very constructive about
its Si Cap business ramp, driven by its world No.1 capacitance density, Foundry
business model (making all MLCC players as potential customers) and already
sold-out capacity. The Si Cap ramp would make Winbond a critical player in
advanced packaging. We remain positive on Winbond for its strong earnings power
(JPMe 2027E EPS NT$60) and its rising AI exposure (DRAM, flash, WoW and Si
Cap). Maintain OW with Dec-26 PT of NT$360 (6x 2027E P/E).

AI 的發展改變產業追求性價比與記憶體單價的傳統，
轉而重視效能、算力及大容量。記憶體市場供需出現結構性改
變。進入3Q26 DRAM 與Flash 的價格仍維持上行趨勢，雖然價
格上漲趨勢較緩，但毛利率仍持續向上。預估華邦電2026 年稅
後EPS 為24.85 元。除AI 伺服器需求外，交換器及Edge AI 應
用亦帶動NOR Flash 與SLC NAND 需求持續成長，華邦電憑藉
NOR Flash 全球市占率第一及SLC NAND 擴產，可望持續受惠。
此外，公司矽電容目前產能接近滿載，受惠AI 先進封裝需求快
速成長，將成為新的獲利來源。過去3~4 個月產業雖歷經多項
利空干擾，但DRAM 及NAND 報價持續走揚，顯示供需結構未
見轉弱，對華邦電建議Buy，目標價200 元(PER8X)。

考量公司3Q26 ASP 漲勢優於先前預期，並且訂單能見度高，
再加上2026 年、2027 年位元出貨量皆有顯著成長，同時公司於此次明
確表態將切入矽電容，有助於降低產業周期循環對於營運的影響。預期
營運至2027 年可望維持高成長態勢，投研部維持強力買進建議，目標
價240 元(2026F PE 8X)。

Management believes the global DRAM supply shortage will become more severe in
2027 and expects DRAM price momentum to continue into 3Q27. Winbond is expanding
DRAM capacity at its Kaohsiung fab from 15k wpm to 24k wpm in 2027, with bit
shipments from this fab likely doubling YoY. For NOR flash, similar to Macronix,
the company sees price-competition pressure in the low-density segment, but views
demand for high-density NOR flash as promising; e.g., next-generation AI server could
require 500-600 pieces of NOR flash per rack, and the company aims to capture a 40-
50% share of this market. We assume 9%/4% higher revenue for Winbond in 2027/28,
given stronger shipment-growth visibility for both DRAM and NOR flash, but our EPS
revision is minimal due to higher opex assumptions (R&D, bonus, etc.). We reiterate our
Buy rating on Winbond with a PO of NT$242 (8x 2027/28E average EPS of NT$30.1).

考量今明年獲利持續上修，並啟動高雄廠擴產計畫，
維持買進評等，TP 225 元(2027 PBR x 2.6)。

儘管近期股價回檔，我們並未觀察到基本面出現反轉，反而認為股價修正提
供布局機會。維持華邦電「增加持股」評等與目標價200元，隱含2027年
1.8倍股價淨值比。目前記憶體族群投資排序為南亞科>華邦電>旺宏。

維持買進評等，目標價上調至208 元，潛在上漲空間34%：
1. 2Q26 毛利率估逾6 成，稅後挑戰逾300 億元。
2. 路竹廠二期提前規畫，CUBE 與矽電容產品具潛力。
3. FY27-28 毛利率低點估58.7%、高點估逾7 成。

We recommend accumulating Winbond stock, supported by two key catalysts:
stronger-than-expected pricing power in niche DRAM and a ramp-up in NOR
shipments to AI servers. We raise our 27E EPS to NT$60 and set a Dec-26 PT of
NT$360 (6x 27E P/E), implying >100% upside. The stock is trading at 2.7x 2027E
P/E and 1.6x 2027E P/B - we view this as an attractive entry point. We believe the
Street underestimates a structural demand driver - eSSD DRAM cache
requirements for DDR4, which could sustain DDR4 tightness and support pricing
over the next two years. In addition, AI servers could contribute 50% of Winbond’s
NOR flash shipments in 2027. Overall, we estimate AI-related (eSSD DRAM and
NOR) could make up one-third of Winbond’s memory revenue in 2027. We also
expect Winbond’s upcoming 2Q26 earnings meeting to be a positive event, as the
management could provide constructive tones on growth strategies.

華邦電受惠利基型記憶體報價上漲，有利毛利率提
升，預估華邦電2026 年稅後EPS 為23.42 元。AI 伺服器單一
機櫃搭載NOR Flash 顆數提高，如Vera Rubin 平台的機櫃需要
搭配高達600 顆以上NOR Flash，為之前2 倍以上的用量。目
前NOR Flash 單價和獲利相較其他記憶體低，且價格穩定，但
隨各廠轉至毛利率較佳的產品，供給也受到限制，NOR Flash 交
期延長，因此價格自2Q26 起上揚，預期2H26 漲幅約60~65%，
為華邦電另一成長動能。近期兆易創新(603986.SH)發布股票交
易風險提示公告，指出存儲晶片目前價格已處於歷史高位，未
來恐出現相當幅度回檔。短期內記憶體報價仍在上漲，華邦電
的基本面沒有明顯改變。不過考量短期市場波動加劇及市場情
緒偏保守， 股價短期有壓，因此將投資評等調降至Neutral，待
市場情緒及籌碼結構趨穩後再重新檢視投資機會。

We raise our PT to NT$288 from NT$222: We continue to apply P/B multiple
methodology to derive our price target, in line with our approach for Greater China
memory IDM peers and in view of the industry's high earnings volatility. Our new price
target (base case scenario value) implies 6.2x 2026e BVPS and 3.4x 2027e BVPS vs. our
prior target multiple of 5.5x 2026e BVPS, as we think DDR4 pricing strength and SLC
NAND/SiCap opportunities could drive re-rating. We raise our bull case value to NT$342
(7.3x our 2026e BVPS) and our bear case value to NT$118 (2.5x our 2026e BVPS).

映出對利基型記憶體需求強勁。由於利基型供給快速收縮，ASP
漲幅高於成本增幅，有利毛利率提升，預估華邦電2026 年稅後
EPS 為23.42 元。過去3 個月記憶體產業面臨多項利空雜音，
包括現貨價格波動、中國供給擴張疑慮、終端需求放緩，及近
期市場對NVIDIA Vera 平台SOCAMM2 配置調整的擔憂。然而
在過去各項利空消息下，DRAM 及NAND 產品報價持續上漲，
顯示產業供需結構及基本面未出現明顯轉弱跡象。先前因半導
體族群波動劇烈，投顧基於風險控管考量，調降投資評等；不
過隨籌碼沉澱及先前市場疑慮逐步降低，投資焦點重新回歸記
憶體循環向上，因此調升至Buy，目標價211 元(PER9X)。

We remain constructive on Winbond and set our Dec-26 PT at a Street-high NT
$255 (based on a 3.0x 2027E P/B, implying a 5.9x 2027E P/E), with our 2026E/27E
EPS 38%/45% above consensus. We believe a higher and longer DRAM/NAND
upcycle would also meaningfully benefit legacy players like Winbond. Key drivers
of Winbond’s DRAM business include capacity upgrade and expansion plans,
strong server-related demand, LTAs with favorable conditions and customized
DRAM. Besides, Winbond is gaining market share and improving profitability for
its flash business (SLC NAND and NOR). In our view, the Street is likely
underestimating Winbond’s EPS power. Key drivers for the stock include this
stronger and longer memory upcycle, continued revenue and profit expansion, and
on-track execution of new capacity and products.
